integrity.method: Integer outward interval determinant signs and signed quadratic defects; analytic uniform tail bound

scientific_limitations: The cutoff is only for the explicit source polynomial, odd geometric frequency bases and eight fixed circle sample points; it is not a universal lowest-degree or lowest-frequency circle counterexample.
Even bases, alternative sampling geometries, arbitrary positive-definite functions and smallest possible matrix sizes are not classified.
Finite signs are established with an executable exact-integer interval computation plus a separate analytic tail bound; no external independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp odd-base transition for a positive-definite Fourier kernel on the circle
